sources.snippet: 📊 Performance First SM70 Flash-V100 resolves --kv-cache-dtype fp8 to E4M3; the 27B release profile explicitly selects fp8_e4m3. DFlash2 verification retains FP32 attention state and FP32 logits on its admitted paths. Keep the Python package and Flash-V100 extension from the same build.
